下部：苍穹无恙第640章不镇杀伐，只定规则
第一节弃暴力镇厄，立疏导大道
百万里虚空漆黑如墨，万古魂潮轰鸣坠落。
那不是寻常仙力对决的冲击，是三万年被埋没、被掠夺、被辜负的亿万修行者，积攒了无数世代的极致怨毒。整片本源虚空都在这股洪流之下剧烈塌陷，空间壁垒层层崩碎，细碎的空间乱流如同锋利的刀刃，在天地间肆意切割。
新生平衡天道雏形莹白通透，万千制衡道纹流转柔和微光，看似圆满稳固，实则根基浅薄、未成恒序。刚刚挣脱旧天道桎梏的新生秩序，还未经历岁月淬炼，根本无力承载这般跨越万古的灭世怨念。
只要魂潮触碰的刹那，这方稚嫩的新天道便会轰然崩解。
届时，新旧秩序双双覆灭，三界重回无序混沌，墨规子遗留的旧有畸形规则，会借着混沌真空期卷土重来，甚至会因这场浩劫变得更加严苛、更加残酷，亿万生灵三万年的苦难，只会无限轮回、永无终结。
九大仙盟残余高层藏匿在天道钱庄核心禁制深处，隔着厚重的法则壁垒，望着虚空之上濒临崩塌的局势，一张张苍老面容上爬满癫狂的笑意。
“天意如斯，非人力可违！”
为首的北洲仙盟盟主须发张扬，眼底满是阴鸷与贪婪，指尖不断掐动法诀，暗中催动钱庄残存的黑暗代码，悄悄加持万古魂潮的毁灭之力，“凌无妄妄图以一己之力颠覆万古定规，打破天尊创下的秩序，今日便要落得天道俱毁、万魂反噬的下场！”
“新旧天道同归于尽，混沌重启，旧规复燃！我们依旧是执掌三界权柄、坐拥万世底蕴的顶层权贵，这些蝼蚁修士，永远只能任我们收割！”
其余几位盟主纷纷附和，阴冷的笑声穿透层层禁制，回荡在本源虚空之中。他们一生依附旧规、垄断资源、吸食万千修士的道果本源为生，早已与畸形的资本天道融为一体。新天道的平衡、公平、开源，于他们而言，便是刨根掘墓的灭顶之灾。
比起顺应新规、褪去特权、沦为凡流，他们更乐见天地倾覆、万物归零。
哪怕三界覆灭、苍生涂炭，只要他们能重掌权柄，一切牺牲、一切浩劫，在他们眼中都不值一提。
虚空之上，新道盟一众修士面色惨白，心神濒临碎裂。
无数弟子握紧手中法器，浑身道力催发到极致，一道道单薄的莹白光纹前赴后继加持在天道屏障之上。可凡人道力之于万古魂潮，如同萤火对阵皓月，刚刚触及漆黑洪流，便被瞬间湮灭，连一丝涟漪都无法激起。
“挡不住……根本挡不住！”
“万古冤屈凝魂，承载三万载制度之恶，这已经不是修士纷争，是苍生对整片旧天地的复仇！”
“凌尊，别无选择了！唯有以无上仙力强行镇杀残魂、磨灭执念，方能保住新生天道，留住三界生机！”
诸多新道盟长老厉声嘶吼，语气满是急切与绝望。在他们认知之中，面对失控灭世浩劫，唯有镇压、屠戮、磨灭，方能止戈维稳，这也是旧天道沿用三万载的唯一治世手段。

从古至今，乱世以杀止乱，异念以力镇压，从来皆是如此。
可立身天道之前的凌无妄，望着扑面而来的毁灭魂潮，眼底没有半分杀伐戾气，只有深沉通透的悲悯。
他肉身之上，法则裂痕已然蔓延全身，细密的血珠从裂痕中渗出，浸透衣衫。燃烧寿元带来的神魂剧痛无时无刻不在侵蚀他的意识，立道反噬的因果枷锁死死缠缚他的周身，每一次呼吸，都带着道基撕裂般的痛楚。
可他身姿挺拔，立在魂潮之前，纹丝不动。
“以杀止怨，以镇平乱，看似速效，实则遗祸万年。”
凌无妄清冷的声音响彻整片虚空，压过魂潮轰鸣、盖过众生哀嚎、震碎反派癫狂，字字句句，振聋发聩。
“旧天道三万载，遇乱则镇、遇怨则压、遇异则诛，看似秩序井然，实则只是将所有矛盾强行封存、所有冤屈强行掩埋。今日镇压一缕执念，明日便会滋生百缕怨毒，世代累加，层层堆积，最终酿成今日万古灭世之劫。”
“我若今日效仿旧道，以武力磨灭万魂、强行平定浩劫，看似护住了新生天道，实则重蹈覆辙。所谓平衡新规，不过是换了一副皮囊的独裁禁锢，今日之怨未消，他日必再起滔天浩劫。”
三万年的制度弊病，三万年的苍生苦难，三万年的规则畸形，从来不是靠杀伐镇压可以根除。
武力可以磨灭残魂形体，却抹不去万古沉积的冤屈；强权可以稳住一时秩序，却稳不住万世人心。
旧道之错，不在于惩戒，而在于只镇恶源，不除恶因；只压民怨，不平沉冤。
凌无妄抬眸，望着漫天沉浮、满目猩红的残魂，望着那些不甘、绝望、悲愤的万古英灵，道心澄澈无波，没有半分居高临下的裁决之意，唯有苍生守护者的赤诚本心。
“你们无罪，苦非你们所造，怨非你们自生，三万载沉冤，该雪！万古积恶，该清！”
“今日我不杀一魂、不镇一念，不以强权压众生之怨，唯以新规定天地之衡，以公道抚平万古之殇。”
话音落地，凌无妄彻底摒弃所有杀伐仙法、镇压神通。
他抬手结印，不再催动攻防道纹，不再凝聚护身结界，尽数燃烧自身寿元、倾尽立道本源，全力推演、固化、落地新生天道的四大底线铁规。
禁止无差别杀伐众生，禁止强行掠夺生灵道基，禁止固化修行阶级壁垒，禁止垄断天地修行资源。
四道通透莹白的规则金纹，自他掌心升腾而起，横贯百万里虚空，层层铺展、层层叠加，化作四张无边无际的规则天网，温柔笼罩整片万古魂潮。
没有凌厉威压，没有毁灭气息，没有镇压禁锢，只有极致的公平、极致的包容、极致的公道。
第二节规则渡万魂，执念逐澄清

Part 2: The Sky is Safe Chapter 640: No killing, only rules
Section 1 Abandon violence to suppress disasters and establish a road of diversion
The void for millions of miles is as dark as ink, and the eternal tide of souls crashes down.
That was not the impact of an ordinary duel of immortal powers, but the ultimate resentment accumulated by hundreds of millions of practitioners who had been buried, plundered, and let down for thirty thousand years for countless generations. The entire original void collapsed violently under this torrent, the space barriers collapsed layer by layer, and the fine space turbulence was like a sharp blade, cutting wantonly between the heaven and the earth.
The embryonic form of the new balanced heavenly path is crystal clear and white, with thousands of checks and balances flowing softly and shimmering. It seems complete and stable, but in fact it has a shallow foundation and has not yet established a permanent sequence. The new order that has just broken free from the shackles of the old heavenly law has not yet been tempered by the years, and it is simply unable to carry such an eternal resentment for the destruction of the world.
As soon as the soul tide touches it, this immature new way of heaven will suddenly collapse.
At that time, both the old and new order will be destroyed, and the three realms will return to disorder and chaos. The old deformed rules left by Mo Guizi will come back through the vacuum of chaos, and will even become more severe and cruel because of this catastrophe. The 30,000-year suffering of hundreds of millions of creatures will only reincarnate infinitely and never end.
The remaining high-level officials of the Nine Immortals Alliance were hiding in the restricted depths of the core of Tiandao Bank. Through the thick barrier of laws, they looked at the situation on the verge of collapse in the void, with crazy smiles on their old faces.
"God's will is so great that no manpower can disobey it!"
The leader of the Beizhou Immortal Alliance must be arrogant, his eyes are full of evil and greed, and he is constantly pinching the magic formula with his fingertips, secretly activating the remaining dark codes of the bank, and quietly blessing the destructive power of the eternal soul tide, "Ling Wuhua is trying to subvert the eternal rules by himself, break the order created by Tianzun, and today he will end up with the destruction of heaven and the backlash of thousands of souls!"
"The old and new ways of heaven will perish together, chaos will be restored, and old ways will be rekindled! We are still the top dignitaries who hold the power of the three realms and possess the heritage of eternity. These ant monks will always be harvested by us!"
The other alliance leaders all agreed, and their cold laughter penetrated the layers of restrictions and echoed in the original void. They have relied on the old rules, monopolized resources, and absorbed the Tao and Fruit of thousands of monks to make a living throughout their lives. They have long been integrated with the deformed capital heaven. To them, the balance, fairness, and openness of the new way of heaven are the ultimate disaster.
Rather than comply with new rules, lose their privileges, and become ordinary, they are more willing to see the world collapse and everything return to zero.
Even if the Three Realms are destroyed and the people are in ruins, as long as they can regain power, all sacrifices and all catastrophes are not worth mentioning in their eyes.
Above the void, the faces of the monks of the New Dao Alliance were pale, and their minds were on the verge of being broken.
Countless disciples clenched the magic weapons in their hands, and the Tao power in their bodies was pushed to the extreme. Thin white light patterns came one after another to bless the barrier of heaven. But the power of mortal Tao against the eternal soul tide is like a firefly against the bright moon. As soon as it touches the dark torrent, it is instantly annihilated without even a ripple being stirred up.
"Can't stop it...can't stop it at all!"
"The souls of eternal grievances bear the evil of the system for 30,000 years. This is no longer a dispute between monks, but the common people's revenge against the entire old world!"
"Ling Zun, you have no choice! Only by using supreme immortal power to forcibly kill the remaining souls and eliminate obsessions can we preserve the new way of heaven and retain the vitality of the three realms!"
Many elders of the New Dao Alliance roared sharply, their tone full of urgency and despair. In their understanding, in the face of an out-of-control catastrophe of world destruction, only suppression, massacre, and annihilation can be used to stop the war and maintain stability. This is also the only method of governing the world that the old heaven has used for 30,000 years.
From ancient times to the present, in troubled times, killing has been used to end chaos, and deviant thoughts have been suppressed with force. This has always been the case.
But before Ling Wuwang established himself in heaven, looking at the wave of destroying souls coming towards him, there was no murderous anger in his eyes, only deep and transparent compassion.
On his physical body, cracks in the law have spread all over his body, and fine blood drops seep out from the cracks.Soaking clothes. The intense pain in his soul caused by the burning Shou Yuan was eroding his consciousness all the time. The causal shackles of the backlash from the establishment of the Tao tightly bound his whole body. Every breath brought pain like the tearing of the Daoji.
But he stood tall and straight in front of the soul wave, motionless.
"Killing to end resentments and quelling chaos may seem like a quick result, but in reality it will cause lasting consequences."
Ling Wuwang's cold voice resounded throughout the void, overpowering the roar of the soul tide, drowning out the wailing of all sentient beings, and shattering the villain's madness. Every word was deafening.
"For thirty thousand years, the old way of heaven suppressed chaos, suppressed grievances, and punished differences. It seemed to be in order, but in fact it just forcibly sealed up all contradictions and forcibly buried all grievances. Suppressing a ray of obsession today will breed hundreds of strands of resentment tomorrow. The accumulation of generations and layers will eventually lead to the catastrophe of eternal annihilation today."
"If I follow the old ways today and use force to wipe out all souls and forcibly quell the catastrophe, it may seem like I have protected the new way of heaven, but in fact I will repeat the same mistakes. The so-called balancing of new rules is just a dictatorial confinement with a skin. If today's grievances are not eliminated, catastrophes will happen again in the future."
Thirty thousand years of institutional ills, thirty thousand years of suffering for the people, and thirty thousand years of irregularities can never be eradicated by killing and suppressing.
Force can erase the body of the remnant soul, but it cannot erase the grievances accumulated throughout the ages; force can stabilize the temporary order, but it cannot stabilize the hearts of all generations.
The fault of the old way is not in punishment, but in that it only suppresses the source of evil but does not remove its cause; it only suppresses people's grievances and does not redress injustices.
Ling Wuwang raised his eyes, looking at the crimson remnant souls floating in the sky, at those eternal heroic spirits who were unwilling, desperate, and angry. His Taoist heart was clear and waveless, with no condescending judgment, only the sincere heart of the guardian of the common people.
"You are not guilty. The suffering is not caused by you. The resentment is not caused by you. Thirty thousand years of injustice should be punished! The evil accumulated throughout the ages should be cleared!"
"Today I will not kill a soul, suppress a thought, nor suppress the resentment of all sentient beings with force. I will only use new rules to establish the balance between heaven and earth, and heal the eternal sorrows with justice."
After the words fell, Ling Wuwang completely abandoned all methods of killing immortals and suppressing magical powers.
He raised his hand to form a seal, no longer activating the offensive and defensive Dao patterns, no longer condensing the protective barrier, burning all his lifespan, devoting all the origin of establishing the Dao, and doing his best to deduce, solidify, and implement the four bottom lines of the new Heavenly Dao.
It is prohibited to kill all sentient beings indiscriminately, to forcibly plunder the Taoist foundations of living beings, to solidify class barriers for cultivation, and to monopolize the resources of heaven and earth for cultivation.
Four transparent white regular golden patterns rose from his palm, spanning millions of miles of void, spreading layer by layer, superimposed layer by layer, turning into four boundless regular sky nets, gently covering the entire eternal soul tide.
There is no harsh coercion, no aura of destruction, no suppression and imprisonment, only ultimate fairness, ultimate tolerance, and ultimate justice.
Section 2: Rules cross thousands of souls, and obsessions are gradually clarified
